title: Message
description: Display global messages as feedback in response to user operations.
whenToUse:
- To provide feedback such as success, warning, error etc.
- A message is displayed at top and center and will be dismissed automatically, as a non-interrupting light-weighted prompt.

examples.name: Hooks usage (recommended)
examples.description: Use `message.useMessage` to get `contextHolder` with context accessible issue. Please note that, we recommend to use top level registration instead of `message` static method, because static method cannot consume context, and ConfigProvider data will not work.

examples.name: Other types of message
examples.description: Messages of success, error and warning types.

examples.name: Customize duration
examples.description: Customize message display duration from default `3s` to `10s`.

examples.name: Stack
examples.description: Stack configuration, disabled by default. Messages will be stacked when the amount is over `threshold`. Only the latest message is shown in the collapsed stack.

examples.name: Message with loading indicator
examples.description: Display a global loading indicator, which is dismissed by itself asynchronously.

examples.name: Promise interface
examples.description: `message` provides a promise interface for `onClose`. The above example will display a new message when the old message is about to close.

examples.name: Custom semantic styles
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of messages with `classNames` and `styles`.

examples.name: Update Message Content
